guardrails.name: verifiability
guardrails.rule: Every corpus claim traces to a source carrier and claim state.
guardrails.failure_response: demote to lead or remove from display

guardrails.name: adjudication distinction
guardrails.rule: Allegation, finding, settlement, discipline, decertification, conviction, acquittal, and exoneration remain separate fields.
guardrails.failure_response: split field and rollback public wording

guardrails.name: civilian privacy
guardrails.rule: Civilian identity display requires privacy class, display class, source, and ethical reason.

guardrails.name: officer due process
guardrails.rule: Pending, contested, reversed, sealed, and exonerating records must be visible as status, not buried.
guardrails.failure_response: update status and attach correction route

guardrails.name: right of reply
guardrails.rule: Officers, departments, and affected civilians need a contest/correction path.
guardrails.failure_response: mark correction route missing and block S5

guardrails.name: no revenge framing
guardrails.rule: Tone and presentation support accountability, not harassment or vigilantism.
guardrails.failure_response: rewrite public surface and review access controls

guardrails.name: police-use access caution
guardrails.rule: The access model must not default to enabling police targeting of individuals.
guardrails.failure_response: hold public deployment until access model is decided

guardrails.name: community data dignity
guardrails.rule: Indigenous, immigrant, bereaved, and structurally vulnerable communities are not merely data subjects.
guardrails.failure_response: consultation or minimization required before display expansion
